newsitem.title: UK: National Grid sees cutting costs.
newsitem.headline: National Grid sees cutting costs.

text.p: British electricity transmission network National Grid Group Plc said on Tuesday its streamlining programme would cut its controllable cost base by an average of about six percent per year in real terms.
The company, posting first-half results, also said it expected to deliver real growth in dividend per share close to the level implied for the periods ended March 1996 and 1997.
National Grid added that it expected to pay a final dividend of 6.68 pence per share, making a total dividend of 11.13 pence per share for the year.

The company said the strength of the forward order book for its Energis telecommunications service supported the view that Energis would be profitable before interest, tax and depreciation for the year ending March 1998.
